newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 26.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Total of 1.5 million vaccines against hog foot and mouth disease arrive in Taiwan.
City, provincial governments to decide on laws guiding use of protective motorcycle helmets.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Three officials of fishermen's union detained for suspected vote-buying.
LIBERTY TIMES - "English Patient" is big winner at Oscars.
Dalai Lamai to meet with Vice President Lien Chan, President Lee Teng-hui.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - U.S. Federal Reserves meets to discuss interest rate hike.
Taiwan money supply measure (M2) reaches highest level in two years.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Panama will not change plans for visit by President Lee despite pressure from communist China.
Taiwan foreign exchange reserves rise to US$88.63 billion.
